_eliot_legacy_compatibility.consumer: Codex production MCP route (codex_controller stdio profile)
_eliot_legacy_compatibility.cutover_blocker: bins/eliot-agent-bridge implements no codex_controller profile: its CLI contract (bins/eliot-agent-bridge/src/cli_contract.rs) admits only --profile SPINE_FUNCTIONAL|FULL_COMPOSITION with --transport stdio|loopback-http and a mandatory --client-declaration <absolute-path>/agent-bridge/client-declaration-v2.json; no such client-declaration file exists in the repository and the codex_controller MCP protocol lives only in the crates/eliot-app facade (src/mcp_stdio.rs). Renaming the executable without that protocol would violate the #18 P1 cutover rule, so the launch edge above is unchanged.
